name: Citizenship by Birth or Descent

qualifying_event.description: Citizenship is conferred automatically at birth for persons born in Grenada on or after 7 February 1974 (independence), and by registration entitlement for persons born abroad to a Grenadian parent.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; for the descent case, proof of the parent's Grenadian citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: Automatic citizenship for anyone born in Grenada on or after 7 February 1974, EXCEPT where, at the time of birth, a parent is an enemy alien or a person not entitled to reside in Grenada under its immigration laws (Constitution, Section 96).

requirement_groups.name: Born abroad to a Grenadian parent

requirements.blocker_text: Born outside Grenada on or after 7 February 1974 to a mother OR father who is a Grenadian citizen -- entitled to be REGISTERED as a citizen (Constitution, Section 97), gender-neutral as to which parent.
Registration must be made by the applicant's 18th birthday.

evidence_required.document: Proof of parent's Grenadian citizenship (descent cases)

sources.title: Constitution of Grenada, Chapter VII (Citizenship), Section 96 (primary legislation): jus soli citizenship for persons born in Grenada on or after 7 February 1974, with enemy-alien and no-immigration-status exceptions

Constitution of Grenada, Chapter VII (Citizenship), Section 97 (primary legislation): entitlement to registration as a citizen for a person born outside Grenada on or after 7 February 1974 to a Grenadian father or mother
Wikipedia -- Grenadian nationality law: confirms the descent-registration deadline as the applicant's 18th birthday

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. Unlike Grenada's own ordinary Citizenship Act (Cap 54), which does NOT contain birth/descent provisions, this route is sourced to the CONSTITUTION (Chapter VII) -- a structural distinction confirmed while researching this build (the Citizenship Act covers registration, naturalisation, and adoption; the Constitution covers citizenship at birth). The descent rule (Section 97) is gender-neutral (either parent transmits) and the Constitution text itself does not state a generational limit, but the 18th-birthday registration deadline is sourced only to Wikipedia (tier 4) -- modelled as hard: false accordingly (informational, not a confirmed blocker), flagged for re-verification against the Citizenship Act's regulations (which likely specify the exact registration procedure and deadline) rather than the Constitution text alone.
